judgment.notes: For N001, both initial data are real mean-zero and in the radius-R H^gamma ball; gamma>0 implies their L2 norms are at most R, so B=2R>0 satisfies the norm-sum condition. Each truncation is smooth, so N013 applies with the same C,tau0 and the chosen integer Lsteps. T>0 and Lsteps>=1 give tau>0, meeting N005's continuous self-map hypothesis. No E or M application occurs. BG001–BG002 justify the routine approximation and norm-limit steps.

Symmetric Fourier truncations remain in the original ball and converge in L2. Exact flows converge uniformly in time by N001; for each fixed admissible timestep the numerical iterates converge by N005 and finite induction. The reverse triangle inequality passes the common N013 error bound to each grid point, and a finite maximum retains it. No uniform continuity in tau or exchange of an infinite grid with the approximation limit is needed. Existence and scheme well-definedness follow respectively from N001 and N005; S003 retains the parameter-only constants and all datum/timestep conditions.
